My name is not important, but I am a young man trying to feed my family from this small piece of land here in Balaka. The rains have been unreliable these past seasons, so I must be careful with what little I spend. I was lucky to get a coupon from the Affordable Inputs Programme this year, so I will use some fertilizer and hybrid seed, and I intercrop my maize with pigeon peas to help the soil. Fall armyworm hit us badly last year, so I bought a small amount of pesticide from the agro-dealer in town, and my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves since the plot is small.
